title: Lieutenant Alverold
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Lieutenant Alverold | image = Lieutenant Alverold.png | level = 20 | type = Elite | faction = Alliance | aggro = {{Aggro|1|-1}} | affiliation = [[Kul Tiras (faction)|Kul Tiras]] | race = Human | creature = Humanoid | gender = Male | location = [[Anchor's Edge]], [[the Barrens]] | status = Killable }} '''Lieutenant Alverold''' is a [[human]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Anchor's Edge]] in [[the Barrens]]. Alverold was one of [[Daelin Proudmoore]]'s lieutenants and made up a part of the fleet which sailed to [[Durotar]] in search of [[Jaina Proudmoore]]. While Proudmoore headed towards land, he ordered Alverold to take an exploratory fleet and scout out the coasts of [[Kalimdor]]. Meanwhile, Daelin did battle with the [[Horde]], and was killed by [[Rexxar]] and his comrades. [[Lieutenant Benedict]] continued Daelin's campaign, and [[Admiral Proudmoore's Orders]] dictated that Alverold had to reinforce him eventually. Upon returning from his expedition, Alverold established the outpost of [[Anchor's Edge]] on an island just south of the [[Echo Isles]] to reinforce Benedict's troops in [[Tiragarde Keep]]. ==Quests== * {{questlong|Alliance|28|The Dragonmaw Conflict}} {{queststartfinish}} * {{questlong|Alliance|30|The Scales of War}} {{queststart}} ==Objective of== * Drops [[Head of Alverold]] for {{questlong|Horde|20+|Lieutenant Alverold (quest)|Lieutenant Alverold}}. ==Quotes== ;Gossip Our journey has taken much longer than expected.
